doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9 (segments in any order), and FBL 0.18, sections 4.9 and 6.3 (a segment as a flag), FR-024: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/decorators.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. Each of the five decorators is a flag of its own (holds), true when a segment of the statement holds it: all five on Everything, none on Unknown, whose one decorator the tool type does not know is kept by no slot, build on Repeated, which writes it twice, and outsource and market around inertia on Reordered. A flag set true is written right after the statement's last decorator, or, on a component with none, after its coordinates; a flag set false removes every segment that holds it, with the whitespace before it; a flag set to the value it reads writes nothing.

steps.doc: Reordered's outsource cleared and buy set, in one edit: (outsource) is removed with the space before it, and (buy) is added right after (market), the statement's last decorator; inertia between them stays.
steps.expect:
title Decorators
anchor User [0.95, 0.5]
component Everything [0.8, 0.5] (market) (ecosystem) (build) (buy) (outsource)
component Unknown [0.7, 0.4] (someDecoratorFromLater)
component Repeated [0.6, 0.3] (build) (build)
component Reordered [0.5, 0.6] inertia (market) (buy)
component Plain [0.4, 0.7]
User->Everything
